stats.fact: Google released ADK for Java 1.0.0 on March 30, 2026 with a new app/plugin architecture, new grounding tools, HITL workflows, and Vertex AI/Firestore session/state integrations
Google announced ADK for Go 1.0 on March 31, 2026 with OpenTelemetry tracing, self-healing plugin behavior, HITL confirmations, and YAML-defined agent configs
ADK documentation positions quickstart paths for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and Kotlin and says a simple agent can be launched in under 20 minutes
ADK Python 2.0.0 release notes describe GA status on 2026-05-19 with a production multi-agent workflow engine, flexible execution graphs, and dynamic inter-agent routing
ADK Python 2.1.0 release (2026-05-23) adds data visualization artifacts and sandbox/template workflows plus UX hardening like MCP tool error handling
